[TODO:it] Each life answers for itself.

[TODO:it] The second brings four talents.
"Well done. Enter into joy."

small_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Two talents earned the same words.
Nothing given is too small.

judgment_one.text:
[TODO:it] The third holds out a dirty coin.
"I was afraid. I hid it away."

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Fear was never his master's wish.
[TODO:it] Tears rise for the buried gift.

defend_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] True humility uses the gift.
